scope: Revision6 native prepared-statement admission, shared provenance/cache and expanded lexical effect-cycle barrier. Prior broader runtime review is preserved; this does not certify unexecuted integration gates.
positive_assessments: Native classification checks the ordered singleton statement family and leading keyword, rejecting CREATE AS EXECUTE and nested/multiple forms. Native names use ASCII-only syntax, 63-byte bound and lowercase lookup; original wire bytes are unchanged.

Every parser token span is checked against the original UTF-8 bytes. Static PREPARE body spans remain metadata inside the accepted whole request. Opaque and lexical policy scans still apply to all productions/tokens.

Immutable cached NativeDecision is connection-independent classification only. ProtocolState applies PREPARE provenance and EXECUTE lookup locally after admission; cache hits cannot create a target on another connection.

Protocol and native names share a table; protocol names remain exact bytes and are capped at63bytes. Portals capture immutable Statement objects. Optimistic acceptance is not backend execution success.

Q/P/B/D/E/C/S mark pending effects before forwarding. Q/Sync enqueue and advance cycle identifiers, and later pending effects survive older Ready. Bind/Execute/Sync/Describe/Close remain available to complete admitted work.

Initial Ready requires idle status and no pending/barrier state. Later Ready requires a queued barrier and valid one-byte status. Backend lexical ParameterStatus is checked before ready clears pending; unsafe or missing initial lexical settings deny readiness.
COPY data/completion does not add orphan pending cycles. Ignored messages have no synthetic acknowledgement path; conservative retention may deny later SQL but does not release uncompleted effects.
